notes: Source is the Mistral Docs model page (https://docs.mistral.ai/models/model-cards/ministral-8b-24-1). It is a product/model catalog page (release date, context, MRL license badge, params, modalities tooltips, features, weights), not a safety system card: no risk tiers, no safety topics, no numeric eval tables. Specs come from the page HTML/RSC (header October 9, 2024 and Context 128k; modalities tooltips Text input and Text output; Weights table Parameters/Active 8/8, Context Size 128k, License MRL). The page links to Blog (mistral.ai/news/ministraux) which has benchmark figures without readable numbers in the text; that blog was not used because seed-lookup listed only this document for the card. No pageCount (web page). alsoDocuments empty per seed-lookup.
